name: Burn First Aid
overview: Burn Emergency Care is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include immediate action can prevent complications; call emergency services for severe presentations. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.

steps.title: Stop the burning process
steps.description: Move away from heat source. Remove smoldering clothing unless stuck to skin.

steps.title: Cool the area
steps.description: Run cool (not icy) water over the burn for 10–20 minutes.

steps.title: Protect the wound
steps.description: Cover with clean, non-fluffy dressing. Do not apply toothpaste or oils.

steps.title: Seek emergency care
steps.description: Call ambulance for large, deep, facial, or electrical burns.

donts: Do not delay care for major burns

faq.question: Can I rely on this burn information instead of a doctor visit?
faq.answer: No. This content supports learning and preparation for conversations with qualified healthcare professionals. It is not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment.

medicalDisclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider.
